facts.fact: Oliver 想在图书馆独读收尾却全程分心，手机不离手。
facts.anchor: My hand hovers over my phone, and I find myself checking it more often than I ever have before.

facts.fact: 自上次见面后 Eden 没离开过他的脑海——胸口像破了个洞，而他甚至还不算真正了解她。
facts.anchor: Like there’s a hole in my chest, and I barely know her.

facts.fact: Eden 本章状态松弛：研究项目开局美妙，让她对来年兴奋。
facts.anchor: My research project has started, and it’s just been fantastic. Makes me excited for next year.

facts.fact: 听说 Oliver 打算一天读完这厚书，Eden 回一句「This would take me years」——毫无恶意、毫无调侃。
facts.anchor: She says that with no malice, no teasing.

facts.fact: Oliver 悟出 Eden 恨 Literature 的无限性与灰色地带；化学凡事有解、皆可证。
facts.anchor: Everything can be proven. Everything can be rationalised.

facts.fact: 家族晚餐每周至少一次，桌上只剩沉默——Oliver 的反讽：真·一家人。
facts.anchor: Just us, eating in silence. Like a real family.

facts.fact: Mum 在世时餐桌上有笑声、色彩与爱；如今三人坐不下这张大桌子。
facts.anchor: It was better when Mum was here. There was laughter, colour, love.

facts.fact: Dad 抛出公司通信岗位招安，说这是让他的写作技能「真正有用」的方式——伤口精准。
facts.anchor: A good way to use your writing skills in a way that actually matters.
